name: cafaye-docs
description: The cafaye documentation site — docs.cafaye.com. Astro + Starlight, static.

scripts.build: npm run sync && astro build && astro build --config notes-site/astro.config.mjs && node bin/emit-markdown
scripts.test: npm run sync && node --test tests/smoke.mjs tests/links.mjs tests/examples.mjs tests/advisories.mjs tests/visibility.mjs tests/api-markdown.mjs tests/secrets.mjs
